subject: Pen test: evidence request and remediation plan for auth & rate-limit findings
messages:
From: Jacob Reed <jacob.reed@acmepay.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-15T09:24:00-08:00
Subject: Request: pen test report + remediation ETA for auth & rate-limit findings

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for running the Q4 pen test with our vendor. Acme needs the full report and a concise remediation plan for two findings that are blocking our SOC 2 checklist: (1) authentication session fixation (authn) and (2) insufficient rate limiting on public inference endpoints.

Could you please:
- Share the pen test report PDF and any attacker traces you can provide.
- Provide a remediation ETA for each finding (high-level steps + owners).
- Tell us whether Redwood will accept a segmented retest (just those two findings) and an expected retest window.

We need the evidence matrix in the format our compliance team uses (spreadsheet with remediation status and artifacts). Preferably by Jan 22.

Jacob Reed
Security Manager, Acme Payments
security@acmepay.com

---
Attachments requested: pen test report, evidence traces, remediation matrix
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Jacob Reed <jacob.reed@acmepay.com>, PenTestCo <reports@pentestco.io>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation ETA for auth & rate-limit findings

Hi Jacob — thanks for the clear ask. We're attaching the pen test report and the traces you requested (see attachments). Quick summary below and a proposed remediation plan.

Attachments included: REDWOOD_PT_Q4_2025_report.pdf, auth-rate-limit-finding-trace.zip, evidence_matrix_acme.xlsx

Summary of the two findings
- Authn: session token reuse under a narrow set of legacy SDK flows. Attack surface limited to SDK v0.8.x clients.
- Rate-limit: lack of global per-IP throttling on our public inference endpoint leading to burstable token consumption under simulated load.

Proposed remediation plan (high level)
- Authn (owner: Markus Klein, infra): patch SDK server-side session validation to reject reused session identifiers; add rotation guidance; rollout to prod in canary, then global. ETA: 3 business days for fix + 2 business days for staged rollout and verification.
- Rate-limit (owner: Marissa Cole, runtime): implement and enforce tiered rate-limiting at edge (per-IP, per-API-key) and integrate with our telemetry for throttling metrics. ETA: 7 business days for initial mitigation (edge rule + alerting), 14 business days for hardened policy across regions.

Retest plan
- We can accept a segmented retest for those findings. Proposed retest window: 5 business days after we mark findings as mitigated (we'll coordinate exact dates). PenTestCo, please confirm availability.

I will circulate an internal remediation assignment right after this and update the evidence spreadsheet.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0123

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-16T08:10:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: remediation tasks & checklist for authn / rate-limit (assignments)

Team —

Per Jordan's response to Acme, I'm taking lead on the authn session-fixation remediation. Quick plan:
1) Reproduce locally using the traces in auth-rate-limit-finding-trace.zip.
2) Add server-side check that binds session token to client fingerprint + timestamp and reject reused tokens older than window.
3) Add new regression test and update SDK compatibility matrix.
4) Deploy to canary (east/us) then expand.

ETA details:
- Repro + unit test: EOD 2026-01-17
- Patch + CI: 2026-01-18
- Canary deploy + smoke tests: 2026-01-19
- Verification & evidence dump (logs + test artifacts): 2026-01-20

I'll attach the logs and a test script to the evidence spreadsheet when ready. Priyom, please hold on secrets rotation changes until I confirm there's no dependency on session format.

-Markus
Engineering Manager, Runtime

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-17T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: remediation tasks & checklist for authn / rate-limit (assignments)

Quick update on rate limiting:
- Implemented per-IP soft limit at the edge (CloudWAF rule) in staging. Observed a 65% reduction in simulated burst throughput.
- Next: promote rule to canary region, add alerting when 90% of limit is hit, and add API-key throttles for bad actor patterns.

ETAs:
- Canary promotion: 2026-01-18
- API-key throttling + telemetry dashboards: 2026-01-21
- Hardened global rollout: 2026-01-29 (depends on SOC-ops signoff)

Note for evidence: I'll export WAF logs and the throttling dashboard snapshots to evidence_matrix_acme.xlsx when promoted to canary.

-Marissa
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime

Subject: Re: Pen test: evidence request and remediation plan for auth & rate-limit findings

Jacob — appreciate the turnaround from everyone. Short consolidated status and firm ETAs for Acme:

Consolidated status
- Authn: patch deployed to canary (east/us) and smoke tests passed. Evidence: unit tests, canary logs, and reproduction script included in evidence_matrix_acme.xlsx. Targeting full rollout 2026-01-19 (completed) and verification artifacts delivered 2026-01-20.
- Rate-limit: edge soft-limit promoted to canary 2026-01-18; API-key throttling + telemetry live in canary 2026-01-21. Global hardening scheduled for 2026-01-29. Evidence: WAF logs, throttling dashboard snapshots attached.

Retest window
- We can host a segmented retest for the two findings. Proposed retest window: Jan 26–28. PenTestCo confirmed availability for that week.

Acceptance criteria for Acme to close items
1) Authn: reproduction steps in the report no longer produce token reuse in canary; logs show rejected reuse attempts.
2) Rate-limit: simulated abuse at previous intensity triggers throttling and is visible in telemetry.

Next steps
- Jacob: can you confirm the retest window (we propose Jan 26–28) and whether the evidence spreadsheet format is acceptable?
- PenTestCo: please confirm final retest scope and any additional artifacts you require.

Thanks — attaching the completed evidence spreadsheet and pen test PDF for your compliance team.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
